t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I'm not sure what advice to give yet as I haven't noticed any patterns or trends, but the different coloured gnomes to the different coloured baskets make sense. I just need to try and remember that advice as I go through the rest of the game.

vb_textbox.text: You need to work out which Gnomes give you the best shot at getting the most mushrooms.In the end I learned that the red,purple, pink and brown gnomes would give you more if a red basket came up, so when the x5 came on the screen, I chose one of these coloured gnomes. If it was a x1 then I would pick another colour.Hope that helps :)
